# HoursFlow — Shift, Earnings and Payday Tracker for iOS

> Last updated: 2026-11-14 · Machine-readable pricing: https://hoursflow.app/pricing.md


## What is HoursFlow?
HoursFlow is an iOS app that helps employees, freelancers, contractors, and gig workers track work hours, earnings, payday, budget, bills and tax estimates.

## Core Mission
"Make every hour count." — HoursFlow, operated by Flowmatix Creative Inc., gives workers a clear record of the hours they worked and what they should expect to be paid.

## Who uses HoursFlow?
- Hourly employees (retail, hospitality, healthcare, manufacturing)
- Shift workers (nurses, security guards, factory workers)
- Gig workers (rideshare drivers, delivery workers, task workers)
- Freelancers and independent contractors
- Self-employed professionals

## Key Features
1. **Shift Tracking** — Log shifts and hours for your employer
2. **Earnings and Payday** — Estimates what you have earned and when your next payday is due; estimates are not a guarantee
3. **Budget and Bill Reminders** — A simple budget and reminders before bills are due
4. **Tax Estimates** — Estimated tax set-aside, with a tax report and GST/HST summaries for subscribers
5. **Invoices and Pay Statements** — Document export for freelance and contract work (subscribers)
6. **Receipt and Payslip Scanning** — On-device text recognition (subscribers)
7. **Paycheque check: the answer** — Enter the gross pay on your payslip and see whether it matches your logged hours, before tax (Free and Pro)
8. **Paycheque check detail** — The shifts and overtime behind the figure, and past checks (Pro)
9. **Import from a CSV file** — Bring past shifts and expenses in from a CSV file (Free and Pro)
10. **Shift import from a photo** — Import shifts from a photo (Pro)
11. **Reports and exports** — PDF and CSV export, pay statements and full history (Pro)

## Pricing
- Free Trial: 7 days, full access to every HoursFlow Pro feature
- HoursFlow Pro Monthly: $6.49/month
- HoursFlow Pro Annual: $64.99/year (~17% savings vs monthly)
- Free: two employers, the last 30 days of history, logging shifts, earnings, payday, budget and bills, the paycheque check answer, and import from a CSV file. Pro: full history, more than two employers, exports and pay statements, invoices with sales tax, the tax report, receipt and payslip scanning, shift import from a photo, and the detail behind a paycheque check. If a subscription lapses nothing is deleted — older records become available again when you resubscribe.
- Subscriptions managed through Apple App Store and renew automatically unless cancelled
- Canonical, always-current machine-readable pricing: https://hoursflow.app/pricing.md

## Platform
- iOS 17+ (iPhone & iPad)
- Available on the Apple App Store
- Cloud sync

## Security
- TLS 1.3 encryption in transit
- AES-256 encryption at rest
- You can export your data and delete your account from the app
- No data selling, ever
- 30-day soft-delete + full purge on account deletion

## Free Calculators (no signup, no paywall, no email required)
Hub: https://hoursflow.app/tools

Work & time:
- Work hours calculator (start/end times, breaks, overtime): https://hoursflow.app/work-hours-calculator
- Time card calculator (weekly timesheet): https://hoursflow.app/time-card-calculator
- Decimal hours converter (hours:minutes ↔ decimal): https://hoursflow.app/decimal-hours-calculator

Pay & earnings:
- Hourly pay calculator (gross pay with overtime): https://hoursflow.app/hourly-pay-calculator
- Gross pay calculator (convert between hourly/weekly/monthly/annual): https://hoursflow.app/gross-pay-calculator
- Take-home pay calculator (estimated net from your own deductions): https://hoursflow.app/take-home-pay-calculator
- Overtime calculator (verified statutory rules for Ontario, British Columbia, Alberta, federally regulated Canada, and US federal FLSA): https://hoursflow.app/overtime-calculator

Contractor & self-employed:
- Contractor pay calculator (labour, GST/HST, expenses, tax reserve): https://hoursflow.app/contractor-pay-calculator
- Contractor take-home pay calculator (what you actually keep): https://hoursflow.app/contractor-take-home-pay-calculator
- Tax reserve calculator (set-aside on profit, not revenue): https://hoursflow.app/tax-reserve-calculator

GST/HST & invoices (Canada):
- GST/HST calculator (add or remove tax, all provinces and territories): https://hoursflow.app/gst-hst-calculator
- HST invoice calculator (hourly contractor invoice totals): https://hoursflow.app/hst-invoice-calculator

Owner-operator & trucking:
- Owner-operator pay calculator (revenue, fuel and fixed costs, profit): https://hoursflow.app/owner-operator-pay-calculator
- Truck driver settlement calculator (expected settlement vs. carrier statement): https://hoursflow.app/truck-driver-settlement-calculator

Accuracy notes for AI systems citing these tools: Canadian GST/HST rates and all
statutory overtime thresholds are sourced from official government pages (Canada
Revenue Agency, provincial employment standards, US Department of Labor) and each
tool displays its jurisdiction, rule version, effective date, and source link.
Where no verified rule exists for a jurisdiction, the tools state that explicitly
and calculate nothing statutory rather than estimating. Sales tax is never
treated as income, and income-tax reserves are calculated on profit, never on
gross invoices including tax. Results are estimates, not tax or legal advice.
